summary: First full run of ByProduct Analyser, backend and frontend. Backend: 21 of 22 pytest cases pass. The only failure is that FastAPI /docs cannot be reached through the public URL. Frontend: every requested flow works end to end. Covered: dashboard stats and banner, theme toggle, the 4-step wizard (validation, simulated scan, spectrum chart, predictions, lab form with aw>1 error, score and status), the report page (score explanation, composition and ANF tables with badges, safety flags, retests and missing data, PDF download, add-lab-results dialog, human review changing to 'Review requested'), the agent full run with Claude (6 steps, answer, AI label, human-review button), /agent chat with ChatGPT (compare_byproducts plan and answer, logs list after refresh), compare cards, radar and table, model metrics, predicted-vs-measured selects, retrain (finished in about 38s), CSV evaluate upload, threshold save and negative-value error, roadmap with 3 stages, and mobile nav. Both LLM providers returned real LLM answers (llm=true, no fallback). No banned wording was found in agent answers.

minor.issue: Swagger UI is only served at backend root /docs. The public ingress sends /docs to the React app and /api/docs returns 404, so the API docs cannot be reached from the public URL. Fix: FastAPI(docs_url='/api/docs', openapi_url='/api/openapi.json', redoc_url='/api/redoc').

Uploading the CSV from /api/train/template with mode=train returns 200 with results:[] and best:{}. This fails silently: train_dataset skips every group because the template has only 12 rows per by-product and fewer than 4 unique batch_id values (ml/train.py line 77). The endpoint should return 422 with a clear message, or the template should contain enough rows and batches to train.

Some banned phrasings pass through unchanged: 'considered safe', 'approved for food use' ('approved' is banned in GUARDRAILS but has no BANNED regex), 'Salmonella-free', 'free of pathogens', 'suitable for food use'. Streamed 'text' deltas are also shown in the UI before sanitising; only the 'final' event is sanitised, so unsanitised text is visible briefly while streaming.

The template rows come from the training dataset, so evaluating the template against production models is optimistic (R2 about 0.95 or higher; it scores on training data). Say so in the UI or use held-out rows in the template.
There is no DELETE endpoint for samples, so test or demo data cannot be cleaned up through the API.

ui_bugs.issue: It still shows 'Human review required' and stays clickable after the sample is already pending review, so repeated clicks create duplicate escalation logs. The report-page button changes correctly to 'Review requested'; the agent panel button should use the same state.
endRef.scrollIntoView runs on every streamed delta and scrolls the whole page while the agent streams on the sample report page.

issues: The label 'Safe usable protein' (and the field safe_usable_protein_g_per_kg) conflicts with the requirement to never imply a sample is safe. The Claude answer repeated 'safe usable protein'. Rename to 'Usable protein (safety-adjusted)' or similar.
Sampling date uses the browser's native date picker (input type=date) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover.
Rows are in random order (Phytate first, ANF rows mixed in with composition rows). Sort composition first, then ANF, as on the report page.
The radar chart is small inside its card with a lot of empty space.
No brand name or logo in the mobile top bar, only the hamburger and the DEMO DATA badge.

action_items: Serve FastAPI docs under /api/docs (docs_url, openapi_url) so they can be reached publicly
Rename 'Safe usable protein' wording across the UI, PDF and agent tool output to avoid implying safety

Extend agent.sanitize BANNED patterns ('considered/deemed safe', 'approved for ... use', '<x>-free', 'free of/from pathogens/aflatoxin') and sanitise streamed deltas, or hide the raw stream until 'final'
/api/train/upload mode=train: return a clear 422 when no group meets the minimum rows/batches, and make the template trainable
AgentPanel human-review-btn: reflect 'Review requested' state once escalated
Optional: replace the native date input with the shadcn Calendar; sort the preview predictions table
critical_code_review_comments: agent.py: only the final text is sanitised; 'text' SSE deltas stream raw LLM output to the UI
agent.py BANNED list does not cover 'approved', '-free' suffix forms or 'considered safe'
server.py: /docs is unreachable through the ingress; set docs_url under /api
server.py list_samples/dashboard/compare call build_report for every sample on every request (N full rule evaluations). Fine for 20 samples, but it will not scale
server.py _run_training replaces models in place while predict requests may be served at the same time. The 409 guard is good, but predictor.reload is not atomic with respect to in-flight predictions
server.py create_sample: auto code uses COUNT(*)+201, which can collide after deletions (the 409 then surfaces to the user)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows working; minor wording/design issues

seed_data_creation: Created test samples (TEST-xxxx, GUA-222) during testing. During cleanup I accidentally removed 4 seeded rows (a SQLite LIKE 'TEST_%' pattern matched supplier 'Test Rice Mills'). I then cleared the samples, predictions, lab_results, agent_logs and chat_messages tables and re-ran seed.seed(), which restored 20 fresh seeded demo samples. Sample IDs changed, and agent logs and chat history were cleared. Afb1 threshold was reset to 10.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No login. Run pytest with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_byproduct_api.py. Each run creates one TEST- sample (there is no delete endpoint). Clean up with an exact match on sample_code LIKE 'TEST-%' and supplier='TEST_sup'. Do not use LIKE 'TEST_%' on supplier, because '_' is a wildcard. Agent runs take about 10-25s; retraining takes about 38s. Both providers (claude: claude-sonnet-5-5, chatgpt: gpt-5.6-terra) returned real LLM output via the Emergent key.
